fields.name: accepted_draft
fields.description: Workflow-owned accepted configuration; isolated from tentative edits.

fields.name: candidate
fields.description: Last valid tentative configuration.

fields.name: preview
fields.description: Rendered trusted output for the last valid candidate.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Changes when snapshot inputs change; stale results are discarded.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.description: Cached fetched results and attempted/pending modules.

fields.name: question
fields.description: Immutable question snapshot and tentative control values.

invariants.expression: tentative changes do not mutate accepted_draft
invariants.description: Acceptance occurs only after validation and Enter.

invariants.expression: header precedes preview; preview precedes question; all on stderr
invariants.description: No preview output leaks into stdout.

events.description: Preview a tentative answer without accepting it.
Accept the validated current answer into workflow state.
Discard the tentative answer and navigate Back.
Merge a bounded module read only if the generation is current.
Reflow the header, preview, controls, and hints.
Transfer input to numbered mode after renderer shutdown.
Workflow is inspecting, generating a face, preparing review, or saving.
Workflow supplies an immutable question snapshot.
Cancel while awaiting workflow cleanup or publication outcome.
Workflow exits with an operational failure.

commands.side_effect: Read only unattempted selected modules under the shared deadline; never write config or spawn font commands.
Cancel pending work and await cleanup; completed publication wins over cancellation.
